result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and wide sidewalks in a mixed-use urban setting. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures may expose pedestrians to risk from turning vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed right turns by vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded lane markings
hazards.description: Roadway markings are somewhat worn, which can lead to lane drift.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Refresh and upgrade crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental patterns.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide roadway under an elevated rail structure, which creates significant visual obstructions due to large support columns. While a high-visibility crosswalk and curb ramps are present, the lack of a median refuge and the shadows cast by the overhead structure reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Infrastructure
hazards.description: Large concrete support columns for the elevated rail structure block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left-center, where columns meet the sidewalk and roadway

hazards.name: Poor Lighting/Shadows
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates deep shadows that can make pedestrians less visible to motorists even during daylight.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area directly beneath the blue steel structure

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond the columns.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Install supplemental lighting on the underside of the elevated structure to illuminate the crosswalk area.

result.summary: The intersection is located beneath a large bridge structure, which creates a shadowed environment and potential visibility issues for all road users. While sidewalks and marked crosswalks are present, the industrial setting and wide roadway geometry suggest a design focused primarily on vehicle throughput rather than pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Overhead Bridge Structure
hazards.description: The bridge and its supports create significant shadows and potential blind spots, reducing the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Top half of the image, spanning the roadway

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstructions
hazards.description: Large vans and trucks parked close to the intersection on the right side obstruct sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway beyond the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing transverse crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental patterns to increase driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Improve lighting levels beneath the bridge structure to eliminate dark spots and ensure pedestrians are visible at all times.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides, but pedestrians face a wide crossing distance under an elevated structure. The presence of a bike lane and traffic signals provides some organization, though dedicated pedestrian signals are not visible.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the width of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Infrastructure
hazards.description: Large support pillars for the elevated structure can create blind spots between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Concrete pillars on the left and right sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Shadowing/Low Visibility
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates deep shadows that may reduce the conspicuity of pedestrians to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Area directly under the blue steel bridge structure

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to clarify crossing intervals.
